name: Acid Splash
description: You hurl a bubble of acid at one or two creatures within 5 feet of each other. Each target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 acid damage (upgrades to 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 11, 4d6 at level 17).

name: Blade Ward
description: You extend your hand and trace a sigil of warding in the air; you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the end of your next turn.

name: Chill Touch
description: You touch a creature, which must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d10 necrotic damage and lose the ability to regain hit points until the start of your next turn. Damage increases to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 11, 4d10 at level 17.

name: Dancing Lights

components.material: a bit of phosphorus or wychwood, or a glowworm

description: You create up to four torch-sized lights within range that shed dim light in a 10-foot radius. You can combine them into one glowing vaguely humanoid form. As a Bonus Action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet.

name: Druidcraft
description: You create a minor natural effect: predict weather for 24 hours, make a flower bloom or seed sprout, create a sensory effect like a rustle of leaves or a puff of wind, or instantly light or snuff a small flame.

name: Eldritch Blast
description: You hurl beams of crackling energy at up to two targets within range (one beam at level 1; two beams at level 5; three at level 11; four at level 17). Each beam requires a spell attack roll and deals 1d10 force damage on a hit.

name: Fire Bolt
description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object. Make a spell attack roll; on a hit, deal 1d10 fire damage (2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 11, 4d10 at level 17). Flammable objects hit by this spell ignite.

name: Friends

components.material: a small amount of makeup applied to the face as this spell is cast

description: You magically emanate a sense of friendship toward one creature you can see within range. The target has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to discern your honesty for the duration. When the spell ends, the creature realizes you used magic on it.

name: Guidance
description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll 1d4 and add the number to one ability check of its choice, rolling the die before or after making the ability check.

name: Light
description: You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by a hostile creature. It sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The spell ends if you cast it again or use an action to dismiss it.

name: Mage Hand
description: A spectral, floating hand appears within range and lasts for the duration. You can use a Bonus Action to control the hand; it can manipulate an object, open a door or container, stow or retrieve an item, or pour out a vial. It can't attack or carry more than 10 pounds.

name: Mending
description: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, or a torn cloak. The repair is seamless. The spell can physically repair a magic item, but can't restore its magic.

name: Message

components.material: a short piece of copper wire

description: You point your finger at a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears your message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear. This spell can pass through barriers.

name: Minor Illusion
description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. A creature that uses its action to examine the sound or image can determine it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

name: Poison Spray
description: You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a puff of noxious gas. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d12 poison damage (2d12 at level 5, 3d12 at level 11, 4d12 at level 17).

name: Prestidigitation
description: This spell is a minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice. You can create a harmless sensory effect, light or snuff a small flame, clean or soil an object, chill or warm nonliving material, make a color or mark appear, or create a trinket or illusory image that fits in your hand.

name: Produce Flame
description: A flickering flame appears in your hand, shedding bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The flame harms neither you nor your equipment. As a Bonus Action, you can hurl the fire at a creature within 60 feet; make a spell attack roll, dealing 1d8 fire damage on a hit (2d8/3d8/4d8 at levels 5/11/17).

name: Ray of Frost
description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a spell attack roll; on a hit, deal 1d8 cold damage and reduce the target's Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. Damage increases to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11, 4d8 at level 17.

name: Resistance
description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll 1d4 and add the number to one saving throw of its choice, rolling before or after making the save.

name: Sacred Flame
description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage (2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11, 4d8 at level 17). The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw.

name: Shillelagh

components.material: mistletoe, a shamrock leaf, and a club or quarterstaff

description: The wood of a club or quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power. For the duration, you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for attack and damage rolls using that weapon, and it deals 1d8 bludgeoning damage on a hit.

name: Shocking Grasp
description: Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock to a creature you try to touch. Make a spell attack roll with Advantage if the target is wearing armor made of metal; on a hit, deal 1d8 lightning damage and the target can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn. Damage increases to 2d8/3d8/4d8 at levels 5/11/17.

name: Spare the Dying
description: Choose a creature within range that has 0 hit points and isn't dead. The creature becomes Stable.

name: Thaumaturgy
description: You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power. Choose one of the following: your voice booms up to three times as loud, you cause flames to flicker or change color, you cause harmless tremors, you create an instantaneous sound, you cause a door or window to fly open or slam shut, or you alter the appearance of your eyes.

name: Thorn Whip

components.material: the stem of a plant with thorns

description: You create a long, vine-like whip covered in thorns. Make a melee spell attack against a target. On a hit, deal 1d6 piercing damage (2d6/3d6/4d6 at levels 5/11/17), and if the target is Large or smaller, pull it up to 10 feet toward you.

name: Toll the Dead
description: You point at one creature you can see within range, and the sound of a dolorous bell fills the air around it. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d8 necrotic damage; if the target is missing any hit points, it takes 1d12 instead. Damage increases to 2d8/2d12 at level 5, 3d8/3d12 at level 11, 4d8/4d12 at level 17.

name: True Strike

components.material: a small piece of copper wire

description: You extend your hand and point a finger at a target within range. You make one attack with a weapon or unarmed strike, or make a spell attack using the spellcasting ability of this spell. For this attack, you use your spellcasting ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls instead of Strength or Dexterity.

name: Vicious Mockery
description: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d6 psychic damage and have Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn. Damage increases to 2d6/3d6/4d6 at levels 5/11/17.

name: Word of Radiance
description: You utter a divine word, and burning radiance erupts from you. Each creature of your choice that you can see within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 radiant damage (2d6/3d6/4d6 at levels 5/11/17).

name: Create Bonfire
description: You create a bonfire on the ground in an unoccupied 5-foot cube within range. Each creature in the bonfire's space when you cast the spell must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 fire damage. The bonfire ignites flammable objects, and any creature that enters its space takes 1d8 fire damage (2d8/3d8/4d8 at levels 5/11/17).

name: Frostbite
description: You cause numbing frost to form on one creature visible within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 cold damage and have Disadvantage on the next weapon attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn. Damage increases to 2d6/3d6/4d6 at levels 5/11/17.

name: Infestation
description: You cause a cloud of mites, fleas, and other parasites to appear momentarily on one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 poison damage and move 5 feet in a random direction (if it can move). Damage increases to 2d6/3d6/4d6 at levels 5/11/17.

name: Magic Stone
description: You touch one to three pebbles and imbue them with magic. You or someone else can make a ranged spell attack with one of the pebbles by throwing it or hurling it with a sling. If thrown, it has a range of 60 feet. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 + spellcasting modifier bludgeoning damage. The spell ends if all three pebbles are thrown or hurled.

name: Mind Sliver
description: You drive a disorienting spike of psychic energy into the mind of one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or take 1d6 psychic damage and subtract 1d4 from the next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn. Damage increases to 2d6/3d6/4d6 at levels 5/11/17.

name: Thunderclap
description: You create a burst of thunderous sound that can be heard up to 100 feet away. Each creature other than you within 5 feet of you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 thunder damage. Damage increases to 2d6/3d6/4d6 at levels 5/11/17.
